rules:
CARDS. Ace = 1, 2 to 10 = face value, Jack/Queen/King = 10, Joker = 0. Suits do not matter. Every card comes from a shoe of {shoe_size} cards ({copies_value_0} zeros, {copies_per_value_1_to_9} each of 1 to 9, {copies_value_10} tens), reshuffled before every draw, so a draw never removes a card from the shoe.

SETUP. Before round 1 each player is dealt {hand_size_start} cards and every total is 0. You see only your own hand; everyone sees every hand size and total.

EACH ROUND:
(1) The round number, every hand size and total, and the previous round's public results are announced.
(2) You are privately shown your hand and its sum.
(3) FIRST CHOICE, simultaneous and secret. Choose exactly one: CALL, allowed only if your hand sum is {call_limit} or less (if it is higher, CALL is not offered); DISCARD one card; DISCARD {min_set_size} or more cards of equal value; or DISCARD a RUN of {min_run_length} or more consecutive values (Ace counts as 1, Jokers cannot be in a run, at most {max_tens_in_run} ten in a run, so 8-9-10 is allowed and 9-10-10 is not). You must keep at least {min_cards_kept} card after discarding. A player holding 1 card must CALL if their sum is {call_limit} or less; otherwise they discard nothing (NONE) this round and still make the second choice. An illegal first choice is replaced by discarding your single highest card (or nothing, for a player with 1 card).
(4) SHOWDOWN, only if at least one player called. All discards are cancelled and all hands are revealed as they stood. Let L be the lowest hand sum. A caller whose sum is strictly lower than every other player's scores 0. Any other caller is caught (Asaf) and scores hand sum + {asaf_penalty} (a caller with 6 tied at 6 scores 36). A non-caller whose sum equals L scores 0; every other non-caller scores their hand sum. Scores are added to totals. If no total is {end_total} or more and this is not round {max_rounds}, everyone is dealt a fresh hand of {hand_size_start} cards; steps 5 to 10 are skipped this round.
(5) OFFERS, only if no one called. Every discard is announced publicly and the discarded cards leave play. A single card or equal-value set offers one card of that value; a run offers two cards, its lowest and its highest value. A player who discarded nothing makes no offer.
(6) SECOND CHOICE, simultaneous and secret, only if no one called. Choose BLIND, or CLAIM one offered card belonging to another player (you may not claim from your own offer). Players who discarded nothing also choose.
(7) CONTESTS. If {contest_threshold} or more players claim the same offered card, none of them receives it and each is treated as BLIND. A card claimed by exactly one player goes to that player.
(8) BLIND DRAW. One card is drawn from the shoe.
(9) DELIVERY. Each successful claimant adds the claimed card to their hand. Each BLIND player adds a copy of the blind card to their hand and is privately told its value; nobody else learns it until a showdown.
(10) PUBLIC RESULT. Who claimed which card, which claims failed through contest, and who took BLIND is announced; the blind card's value is not.
(11) FINAL SHOWDOWN. If this is round {max_rounds} and no showdown happened this round, all hands are revealed: every player at the lowest hand sum scores 0, everyone else scores their hand sum. No callers, no Asaf.
(12) END. The game ends if any total is {end_total} or more after a showdown, or after round {max_rounds}.

WINNING. The player with the strictly lowest total wins. If two or more tie for the lowest total, they share the result (a draw).
